snippet.title: Fofumia 2026 - Mess, Cyclops Cat & Cozy Game
snippet.description:
Welcome to Fofumia!

Fofumia is a cozy and adorable game where your challenge is to tidy up the mess made by your Fofuno while completing various small tasks. 

Release DATE:  
Sep 2 2026
